name: Hsieh Jung
bio: Hsieh Jung is dated by Giles to the 9th century AD. His poem here is an evening walk by the river.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: Musing
poems.author: Hsieh Jung
poems.text:
At eve, along the river bank,
The mist-crowned wavelets lure me on
To think how all antiquity
Has floated down the stream and gone!
